mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero mean).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 9.5% indicates weak labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when UNRATE exceeds 9.5% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero mean).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST < 600 and RSAFS < 370000) signal a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic contraction fears intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST < 600 and RSAFS < 370000 (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero mean).

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index above 220 indicates elevated inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 220 (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero mean).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 90 (INDPRO < 90) signals a contraction in manufacturing and services output, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when INDPRO < 90 (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero mean).

mechanism_narrative: A lower HOUST level (thousands of units) is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as it reflects reduced consumer confidence and economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when HOUST is below its 10-year median (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero mean).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales below 370 billion (RSAFS < 370000) indicates weak consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate earnings face pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when RSAFS < 370000 (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero mean).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 220) creates stagflationary conditions that depress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5 and CPIAUCSL > 220 (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero mean).
